none: PAS SUSS-6A0475: Roman Copper Alloy Nummus
contea di ritrovamento: West Sussex (Inghilterra e Galles)

A worn but complete Roman nummus, probably of Constantius II as Caesar (c. 323-336 AD). Reverse type dates to c. 324-330 AD. Mint mark: [?C]ON[S]. Obverse: laureate, draped and cuirassed bust facing left. Obverse legend: [FL] [I]VL CONSTANTIVS NOB C. Reverse: camp gate, two turrets, no doors; star above, six stone layers. Reverse legend: [PR]OVIDEN-[TIAE] (CAESS). Discussion: The mint is…
